backgrounds.description:
Mid range field recording of the area in front of the New York Times building in New York, taken next to the building on the corner of 8th Ave and West 40th St. Cars can be heard driving by, horns are honked, brakes are trodden etc. A sweeper vehicle features sometimes.
People can rarely be heard, as the recording was done at about 6 AM on a Saturday morning in March 2012.
Recorded with a Zoom H2, mics set to 90° dispersion.
